title: chore: gitignore .claude/ and .codex
body:
## Summary
- Adds `.claude/` and `.codex` to `.gitignore` (per-user state from local AI coding tools)
- This commit was on PR #30 but missed the merge window

## Test plan
- [ ] `git status` no longer shows `.claude/` or `.codex` as untracked
